events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day. His guitar still screams.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. What's your go-to track from that iconic album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde, lead vocalist and primary songwriter of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable cool.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, lead singer of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971, in the US and October 24, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: Apple iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod, a portable digital music player, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod. Remember scrolling through your entire music library on that click wheel?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite 007 and which theme song gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His spirit and music continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album'. Double LP, double the classics.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. The showman, the voice, the legend.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal moment in pop history.

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message live on.
